hooksDispatchModel: Pi does not spawn the shepherd binary once per event the way hooks/hooks.json's command/args exec form does. src/extension.mjs is loaded once and registers in-process pi.on(event, handler) callbacks for the life of the session; each handler below calls into the fl03:shepherd component and the native shepherd binary directly (invokeNativeDispatch). This block declares what src/extension.mjs already implements — it adds no new enforcement. hooks/tests/test_pi_manifest_drift.sh is the tripwire that keeps this declaration and src/extension.mjs from drifting apart.

session_start.behavior: normalizes identity, plans lifecycle, calls shepherd dispatch bind-root; throws (fail-closed) if the component is unavailable

tool_call.behavior: calls shepherd dispatch resolve then guardWithComponent; returns {block: true, reason} on every error path (fail-closed)

session_shutdown.behavior: no-op, declared for lifecycle parity with the other two harnesses
